snippet.title: Bhangarh: The Untold Story | Official Gameplay Reveal
snippet.description:
This is where the real gameplay begins.

Paranormal activity reacts to your movement, new routes open as you solve environmental challenges, and each step drags you further into a place that wants you gone. Lights fail, shadows shift, and something unseen locks onto you the moment you make a mistake. Your only hope is to stay ahead of what’s stalking you.

If you want more horror gameplay like this, don’t forget to hit Like, drop a comment, and subscribe.
It helps us reach more players and keeps the trailers coming.
